sentences.zh: 求次氣

translations.literal: Seek next qi.
translations.idiomatic: To find the next solar term.

sentences.zh: 置天正冬至大小余，以氣策及余累加之，秒盈秒母從分，分滿日法從日，即得次氣日及余分秒。

translations.literal: Set winter solstice major and minor remainders of heaven's first month; add qi divisor and remainder cumulatively; seconds full second mother carry to fen; fen full day unit carry to days; then obtain next qi day and remainder fen seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Set the major and minor remainders of the civil-year winter solstice and add the qi divisor and its remainder cumulatively; when seconds fill the second divisor, carry to parts, and when parts fill the day unit, carry to days; the day and remainder in parts and seconds of the next solar term are thereby obtained.

sentences.zh: 求天正經朔

translations.literal: Seek mean new moon of heaven's first month.
translations.idiomatic: To find the mean new moon of the civil year.

sentences.zh: 置通積分，滿朔實去之，不盡，為閏余；

translations.literal: Set universal accumulated parts; full new-moon constant remove it; not exhausted, is intercalation remainder;
translations.idiomatic: Set the universal accumulated parts, divide by the synodic-month constant and take the remainder as the intercalation remainder;

sentences.zh: 以減通積分，為朔積分；

translations.literal: Use it to subtract universal accumulated parts; this is new-moon accumulated parts;
translations.idiomatic: subtract this from the universal accumulated parts to obtain the new-moon accumulated parts;

sentences.zh: 滿旬周，去之，不盡，如日法而一，為日，不盡，為余，即得所求天正經朔大小余也。

translations.literal: Full ten-day cycle, remove it; not exhausted, as day unit and one, for days; not exhausted, for remainder; then obtain sought mean new moon major and minor remainders of heaven's first month.
translations.idiomatic: divide by the ten-day cycle and discard the quotient; with the remainder, divide by the day unit to obtain days, and what remains becomes the fractional remainder; the major and minor remainders of the sought civil-year mean new moon are thereby obtained.

sentences.zh: 求弦望及次朔

translations.literal: Seek quarter and full moons and next new moon.
translations.idiomatic: To find the quarter and full moons and the next new moon.

sentences.zh: 置天正經朔大小余，以象策累加之，即各得弦望及次朔經日及余秒也。

translations.literal: Set mean new moon major and minor remainders of heaven's first month; add image divisor cumulatively; then each obtains quarter and full moons and next new moon mean day and remainder seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Set the major and minor remainders of the civil-year mean new moon and add the quarter-moon divisor cumulatively; the mean days and remainders in seconds for each quarter moon, full moon, and subsequent new moon are thereby obtained.

sentences.zh: 求沒日

translations.literal: Seek extinction day.
translations.idiomatic: To find the extinction day.

sentences.zh: 置有沒之氣恒氣小余，如沒限以上，為有沒之氣；

translations.literal: Set the constant qi minor remainder of the qi that has extinction; if it reaches extinction limit or above, it is a qi that has extinction;
translations.idiomatic: Set the minor remainder of the constant qi for a term that bears an extinction; if it reaches the extinction limit or above, that term has an extinction;

sentences.zh: 以秒母乘之，內其秒，用減四十七萬七千五百五十六；

translations.literal: Multiply by second mother, include its seconds, use to subtract 477,556;
translations.idiomatic: multiply by the second divisor and include the seconds, then subtract the result from 477,556;

sentences.zh: 余，滿六千八百五十六而一；

translations.literal: Remainder, full 6,856 and one;
translations.idiomatic: with the remainder, divide by 6,856;

sentences.zh: 所得並入恒氣大余內，命壬戌算外，即得為沒日也。

translations.literal: What is obtained, together enter within constant qi major remainder; count from renxu beyond the rod; then obtain as extinction day.
translations.idiomatic: add the quotient to the major remainder of the constant qi, count from renxu beyond the counting rod, and the extinction day is obtained.

translations.idiomatic: To find the annihilation day.

translations.idiomatic: Set the minor remainder of the new moon that bears an annihilation,

translations.literal: Six multiply it; as 491 and one;
translations.idiomatic: multiply by six and divide by 491;

sentences.zh: 所得並經朔大余，命為滅日。

translations.literal: What is obtained, together with mean new-moon major remainder; count as annihilation day.
translations.idiomatic: add the quotient to the mean new moon's major remainder to obtain the annihilation day.

sentences.zh: 求七十二候

translations.literal: Seek seventy-two hou.
translations.idiomatic: To find the seventy-two hou.

sentences.zh: 置節氣大小余，命之為初候；

translations.literal: Set solar term major and minor remainders; count it as first hou;
translations.idiomatic: Set the major and minor remainders of the solar term and designate them as the first hou;

sentences.zh: 以候策累加之，即得次候及末候也。

translations.literal: With hou divisor add cumulatively; then obtain next hou and final hou.
translations.idiomatic: add the hou divisor cumulatively to obtain the second hou and the final hou.

sentences.zh: 求六十四卦

translations.literal: Seek sixty-four hexagrams.
translations.idiomatic: To find the sixty-four hexagrams.

sentences.zh: 置中氣大小余，命之為公卦；

translations.literal: Set mid-qi major and minor remainders; count it as duke hexagram;
translations.idiomatic: Set the major and minor remainders of the mid-term and designate them as the duke hexagram;

sentences.zh: 以卦策累加之，得辟卦；

translations.literal: With hexagram divisor add cumulatively; obtain lord hexagram;
translations.idiomatic: add the hexagram divisor cumulatively to obtain the lord hexagram;

sentences.zh: 又加，得候內卦；

translations.literal: Add again; obtain inner hou hexagram;
translations.idiomatic: add again to obtain the inner hou hexagram;

sentences.zh: 以貞策加之，得節氣之初，為候外卦；

translations.literal: With zhen divisor add it; obtain solar term's beginning; this is outer hou hexagram;
translations.idiomatic: add the zhen divisor to reach the beginning of the solar term, which is the outer hou hexagram;

sentences.zh: 又以貞策加之，得大夫卦；

translations.literal: Again with zhen divisor add it; obtain great officer hexagram;
translations.idiomatic: add the zhen divisor again to obtain the great officer hexagram;

sentences.zh: 又以卦策加之，為卿卦也。

translations.literal: Again with hexagram divisor add it; this is minister hexagram.
translations.idiomatic: add the hexagram divisor again to obtain the minister hexagram.

sentences.zh: 求土王用事以貞策減四季中氣大小余，即得土王用事日也。

translations.literal: Seek Earth's kingship in office: use zhen divisor to subtract four seasons mid-qi major and minor remainders; then obtain Earth's kingship in office day.
translations.idiomatic: To find the day when Earth holds royal sway: subtract the zhen divisor from the major and minor remainders of the mid-terms of the four seasons, and the day of Earth's royal sway is obtained.

translations.literal: Seek issuing and gathering.
translations.idiomatic: To find the issuing and gathering.

translations.literal: Set minor remainder; six multiply it; as chen method and one, for chen count;
translations.idiomatic: Set the minor remainder, multiply by six, and divide by the double-hour divisor to obtain the double-hour count;

sentences.zh: 不盡，以刻法除為刻，命子正算外，即得加時所在辰刻分也。

translations.literal: Not exhausted, use ke method to divide for ke; count from zi zheng beyond the rod; then obtain the chen ke fen of the added hour's location.
translations.idiomatic: with the remainder, divide by the quarter-hour divisor to obtain quarter-hours; count from midnight beyond the counting rod, and the double-hour, quarter-hour, and parts of the time-of-day are obtained.

sentences.zh: 求經朔弦望入氣

translations.literal: Seek mean new moon, quarter, and full moons' entry into qi.
translations.idiomatic: To find the solar term entered by the mean new moon, quarter moon, and full moon.

sentences.zh: 置天正閏余，以日法除為日，不滿，為余。

translations.literal: Set heaven's first month intercalation remainder; day unit divide for days; not full, for remainder.
translations.idiomatic: Set the civil-year intercalation remainder, divide by the day unit to obtain days, and what does not fill a day becomes the remainder.

sentences.zh: 如氣策以下，以減氣策，為入大雪氣；

translations.literal: If it reaches qi divisor or below, use it to subtract qi divisor; for entry into Great Snow qi;
translations.idiomatic: If it reaches the qi divisor or below, subtract it from the qi divisor to obtain entry into the Great Snow term;

sentences.zh: 以上，去之，余亦以減氣策，為入小雪氣；

translations.literal: If above, remove it; remainder also use to subtract qi divisor; for entry into Lesser Snow qi;
translations.idiomatic: if above, discard one qi divisor; with the remainder also subtract the qi divisor to obtain entry into the Lesser Snow term;

sentences.zh: 即得天正經朔入氣日及余也。

translations.literal: Then obtain heaven's first month mean new moon's entry-into-qi day and remainder.
translations.idiomatic: the day and remainder of the civil-year mean new moon's entry into a solar term are thereby obtained.

translations.idiomatic: Add the quarter-moon divisor cumulatively and, when it fills the qi divisor, discard the quotient to obtain the day and remainder of entry into the next term for the quarter and full moons;

translations.idiomatic: by the same addition the day and remainder of the next new moon's entry into a term are obtained.

translations.idiomatic: Add or subtract the daily difference from the term's initial increase-decrease rate to obtain the daily increase-decrease rate;

sentences.zh: 馴積損益其氣盈縮朓朒積，為每日盈縮朓朒積。

translations.literal: In sequence accumulate increase-decrease its qi's expansion-contraction and wanings-waxings accumulation; for each day's expansion-contraction and wanings-waxings accumulation.
translations.idiomatic: accumulate in sequence the increase-decrease applied to the term's expansion-contraction and waning-waxing totals to obtain the daily expansion-contraction and waning-waxing accumulations.

sentences.zh: 求經朔弦望入氣朓朒定數

translations.literal: Seek mean new moon, quarter, and full moons' entry-into-qi wanings-waxings fixed number.
translations.idiomatic: To find the fixed waning-waxing number for the mean new moon, quarter moon, and full moon at their entry into a term.

sentences.zh: 以各所求入氣小余，以乘其日損益率，如日法而一；

translations.literal: With each sought entry-into-qi minor remainder, multiply its day's increase-decrease rate; as day unit and one;
translations.idiomatic: Multiply each sought entry-into-qi minor remainder by that day's increase-decrease rate and divide by the day unit;

sentences.zh: 所得，損益其下朓朒積，為定數。

translations.literal: What is obtained, increase-decrease its below wanings-waxings accumulation; for fixed number.
translations.idiomatic: add or subtract the result from the waning-waxing accumulation below to obtain the fixed number.

translations.idiomatic: (This directly gives the fixed waning-waxing number for the mid-term new moon, quarter moon, and full moon.)〉

translations.literal: Seek winter solstice equatorial solar degrees.
translations.idiomatic: To find the winter solstice equatorial solar degree.

sentences.zh: 置通積分，以周天分去之；

translations.literal: Set universal accumulated parts; circuit-of-heaven parts remove it;
translations.idiomatic: Set the universal accumulated parts and divide by the circuit-of-heaven parts;

sentences.zh: 余，日法而一，為度，不滿，退除為分秒；

translations.literal: Remainder, day unit and one, for degrees; not full, retreat-divide for fen seconds;
translations.idiomatic: with the remainder, divide by the day unit to obtain degrees, and reduce what does not fill a degree into parts and seconds;

sentences.zh: 以百為母，命起赤道虛宿六度外，去之，不滿宿，即得所求年天正冬至加時日躔赤道宿度及分秒。

translations.literal: With 100 as mother, count from equatorial Emptiness lodge 6 degrees beyond; remove it; not full lodge; then obtain sought year's heaven's first month winter solstice added-hour sun's motion equatorial lodge degrees and fen seconds.
translations.idiomatic: with 100 as divisor, count from 6 degrees beyond Emptiness in the equatorial lodges and discard full lodges; the remainder gives the equatorial lodge, degrees, and parts-seconds of the sun at the winter solstice of the sought year with time-of-day.

translations.literal: Opening angle bracket.

sentences.zh: （其在尋斯幹之東西者，先以裏差加減通積分。）〉

translations.literal: (Those east and west of Xingis Khan, first use inner difference to add-subtract universal accumulated parts.)〉
translations.idiomatic: (For places east and west of Xanadu, first apply the inner difference to add or subtract from the universal accumulated parts.)〉

sentences.zh: 求春分夏至秋分赤道日度

translations.literal: Seek spring equinox, summer solstice, and autumn equinox equatorial solar degrees.
translations.idiomatic: To find the equatorial solar degrees at the spring equinox, summer solstice, and autumn equinox.

sentences.zh: 置天正冬至加時赤道日度，累加象限，滿赤道宿次，去之，即各得春分、夏至、秋分加時日在宿度及分秒。

translations.literal: Set heaven's first month winter solstice added-hour equatorial solar degrees; cumulatively add image limit; full equatorial lodge sequence remove it; then each obtains spring equinox, summer solstice, autumn equinox added-hour sun's day in lodge degrees and fen seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Set the equatorial solar degree at the civil-year winter solstice with time-of-day, add the quadrant limit cumulatively, and when it fills the equatorial lodge sequence discard the quotient; the lodge, degrees, and parts-seconds of the sun at the spring equinox, summer solstice, and autumn equinox with time-of-day are thereby obtained.

sentences.zh: 求四正赤道宿積度

translations.literal: Seek four correctives' equatorial lodge accumulated degrees.
translations.idiomatic: To find the accumulated equatorial lodge degrees after the four cardinal points.

sentences.zh: 置四正赤道宿全度，以四正赤道日度及分秒減之，余為距後度；

translations.literal: Set four correctives' equatorial lodge full degrees; with four correctives' equatorial solar degrees and fen seconds subtract it; remainder is degrees after the interval;
translations.idiomatic: Set the full degree of the equatorial lodge at each cardinal point, subtract the equatorial solar degree and parts-seconds at that cardinal point, and the remainder is the degrees after the interval;

sentences.zh: 以赤道宿度累加之，各得四正後赤道宿積度及分秒。

translations.literal: With equatorial lodge degrees add cumulatively; each obtains after four correctives equatorial lodge accumulated degrees and fen seconds.
translations.idiomatic: add the equatorial lodge degrees cumulatively to obtain the accumulated equatorial lodge degrees and parts-seconds after each cardinal point.

sentences.zh: 求赤道宿積度入初末限

translations.literal: Seek equatorial lodge accumulated degrees' entry into beginning and end limits.
translations.idiomatic: To find whether the accumulated equatorial lodge degrees fall within the beginning or end limit.

sentences.zh: 視四正後赤道宿積度及分，在四十五度六十五分五十四秒半以下，為入初限；

translations.literal: Observe after four correctives equatorial lodge accumulated degrees and fen; if at 45 degrees 65 fen 54 seconds and a half or below, is entry into beginning limit;
translations.idiomatic: Inspect the accumulated equatorial lodge degrees and parts after a cardinal point; if they are 45 degrees 65 parts 54½ seconds or below, they fall within the beginning limit;

sentences.zh: 以上者，用減象限，余為入末限。

translations.literal: If above, use to subtract image limit; remainder is entry into end limit.
translations.idiomatic: if above, subtract from the quadrant limit; the remainder falls within the end limit.

translations.idiomatic: Set the beginning- or end-limit degrees and parts for the equatorial lodge after a cardinal point and subtract 101 degrees;

sentences.zh: 余，以初末限度及分乘之，進位，滿百為分，分滿百為度；

translations.literal: Remainder, with beginning-end limit degrees and fen multiply it; advance place; full 100 for fen; fen full 100 for degrees;
translations.idiomatic: multiply the remainder by the beginning- or end-limit degrees and parts, carry when needed, and when the product fills 100 convert to parts, and when parts fill 100 convert to degrees;

sentences.zh: 至後以減、分後以加赤道宿積度，為其宿黃道積度；

translations.literal: After solstice use subtract; after equinox use add equatorial lodge accumulated degrees; for its lodge's ecliptic accumulated degrees;
translations.idiomatic: after a solstice subtract from, and after an equinox add to, the accumulated equatorial lodge degrees to obtain the lodge's accumulated ecliptic degrees;

translations.idiomatic: subtract the previous lodge's accumulated ecliptic degrees,

translations.literal: The foregoing ecliptic lodge degrees, according to this calendar's annual precession position are calculated and fixed.
translations.idiomatic: The ecliptic lodge degrees given above are fixed by calculation according to the annual precession in the present calendar.

sentences.zh: 如上考往古，下驗將來，當據歲差，每移一度，依術推變當時宿度，然後可步七曜，知其所在。

translations.literal: As above examine antiquity, below verify the future; one ought to rely on annual precession; each shift of one degree, according to the method derive and transform the lodge degrees of that time; only then can one step the seven luminaries and know their whereabouts.
translations.idiomatic: As when examining antiquity above and verifying the future below, one must rely on annual precession: for each shift of one degree, derive the lodge degrees of that epoch by the prescribed method; only then can the seven luminaries be stepped and their positions known.

sentences.zh: 求天正冬至加時黃道日度

translations.literal: Seek heaven's first month winter solstice added-hour ecliptic solar degrees.
translations.idiomatic: To find the ecliptic solar degree at the civil-year winter solstice with time-of-day.

sentences.zh: 以冬至加時赤道日度分秒，減一百一度，余以冬至加時赤道日度及分秒乘之，進位，滿百為分，分滿百為度，命曰黃赤道差；

translations.literal: With winter solstice added-hour equatorial solar degrees fen seconds, subtract one hundred one degrees; remainder with winter solstice added-hour equatorial solar degrees and fen seconds multiply it; advance place; full one hundred for fen; fen full one hundred for degrees; named yellow-red difference;
translations.idiomatic: From the equatorial solar degree and parts-seconds at the winter solstice with time-of-day, subtract 101 degrees; multiply the remainder by that equatorial degree and its parts-seconds, carry when needed, and when the product fills 100 convert to parts and when parts fill 100 convert to degrees—this is the yellow-red difference;

sentences.zh: 用減冬至加時赤道日度及分秒，即得所求年天正冬至加時黃道日度及分秒。

translations.literal: Use to subtract winter solstice added-hour equatorial solar degrees and fen seconds; then obtain the sought year's heaven's first month winter solstice added-hour ecliptic solar degrees and fen seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract this from the equatorial solar degree and parts-seconds at the winter solstice with time-of-day to obtain the ecliptic solar degree and parts-seconds at the civil-year winter solstice of the sought year with time-of-day.

sentences.zh: 求二十四氣加時黃道日度

translations.literal: Seek twenty-four qi added-hour ecliptic solar degrees.
translations.idiomatic: To find the ecliptic solar degree with time-of-day for each of the twenty-four solar terms.

sentences.zh: 置所求年冬至日躔黃赤道差，以次年黃赤道差減之，余以所求氣數乘之，二十四而一；

translations.literal: Set the sought year's winter solstice sun's motion yellow-red difference; with next year's yellow-red difference subtract it; remainder with sought qi's number multiply it; twenty-four and one;
translations.idiomatic: Set the yellow-red difference at the winter solstice sun's position for the sought year, subtract the next year's yellow-red difference, multiply the remainder by the number of the term sought, and divide by twenty-four;

sentences.zh: 所得，以加其氣中積度及約分，以其氣初日盈縮數盈加縮減之，用加冬至加時黃道日度，依宿次去之，即各得其氣加時黃道日躔宿度及分秒。

translations.literal: What is obtained, use to add its qi's mid accumulated degrees and approximate fen; with its qi's first-day expansion-contraction number, where full add and where contracted subtract; use to add winter solstice added-hour ecliptic solar degrees; according to lodge sequence remove it; then each obtains its qi's added-hour ecliptic sun's motion lodge degrees and fen seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Add the result to that term's mid-term accumulated degrees and rounded parts; apply the term's first-day expansion-contraction value—add when in surplus, subtract when in contraction—and add this to the ecliptic solar degree at the winter solstice with time-of-day; discard full lodges in lodge sequence to obtain each term's ecliptic lodge, degrees, and parts-seconds of the sun's motion with time-of-day.

translations.literal: Opening angle bracket.

sentences.zh: （如其年冬至加時赤道宿度空分秒在歲差以下者，即加前宿全度，然求黃赤道差，余依術算。）〉

translations.literal: (If that year's winter solstice added-hour equatorial lodge degrees' empty fen seconds are below annual precession, then add the previous lodge's full degrees, then seek yellow-red difference; remainder according to method calculate.)〉
translations.idiomatic: (If the fractional parts of the equatorial lodge degree at the winter solstice with time-of-day fall below the annual precession value, add the previous lodge's full degree before computing the yellow-red difference; compute the remainder by the prescribed method.)〉

sentences.zh: 求二十四氣及每日晨前夜半黃道日度

translations.literal: Seek twenty-four qi and each day's before-dawn and midnight ecliptic solar degrees.
translations.idiomatic: To find the ecliptic solar degree before dawn and at midnight for each solar term and each day.

sentences.zh: 副置其恒氣小余，以其氣初日損益率乘之，

translations.literal: Assistant-set its constant qi's minor remainder; with its qi's first-day increase-decrease rate multiply it,
translations.idiomatic: Set aside the minor remainder of its constant qi and multiply it by that term's first-day increase-decrease rate,

translations.literal: Opening angle bracket.

sentences.zh: （盈縮之損益。）〉

translations.literal: (Expansion-contraction's increase-decrease.)〉

translations.idiomatic: Subtract the central-earth solstitial gnomon lengths likewise to obtain the central-earth solstitial gnomon difference.

sentences.zh: 其所求日在冬至後初限、夏至後末限者，如在半限以下，倍之；

translations.literal: Its sought day in winter solstice after beginning-limit, summer solstice after end-limit, if like half-limit or below, double it;
translations.idiomatic: When the sought day falls in the beginning-limit after winter solstice or the end-limit after summer solstice, if equal to or below the half-limit, double it;

sentences.zh: 半限以上，覆減全限，余亦倍之；

translations.literal: Half-limit at or above, turnback subtract full limit; remainder also double it;
translations.idiomatic: if above the half-limit, subtract the full limit in reverse and double the remainder as well;

sentences.zh: 並入限日，三因，折半，以日為分，十分為寸，以減地中二至晷差，為法；

translations.literal: Together entry-limit days, three multiply, halve, with day for fen, ten fen for cun, use to subtract central-earth two-solstice gnomon difference, for divisor;
translations.idiomatic: Add the days within the limit, multiply by three, and halve; take days as parts and ten parts as one cun, subtract from the central-earth solstitial gnomon difference to obtain the divisor;

sentences.zh: 置地中冬至晷影常數，以所求日地中晷影定數減之，余以其處二至晷差乘之，為實；

translations.literal: Set central-earth winter solstice gnomon shadow constant number; with sought day central-earth gnomon shadow fixed number subtract it; remainder with its place two-solstice gnomon difference multiply it; for dividend;
translations.idiomatic: Set the central-earth winter-solstice gnomon-shadow constant, subtract the fixed central-earth gnomon shadow for the sought day, and multiply the remainder by that place's solstitial gnomon difference for the dividend;

sentences.zh: 實如法而一，所得，以減其處冬至晷數，即得其處其日晷影定數。

translations.literal: Dividend as divisor and one; what is obtained, use to subtract its place winter solstice gnomon number; then obtain its place that day's gnomon shadow fixed number.
translations.idiomatic: Divide the dividend by the divisor; subtract the result from that place's winter-solstice gnomon length to obtain the fixed gnomon shadow for that place on that day.

sentences.zh: 所求日在夏至後初限、冬至後末限者，如在半限以下，倍之；

translations.literal: Sought day in summer solstice after beginning-limit, winter solstice after end-limit, if like half-limit or below, double it;
translations.idiomatic: When the sought day falls in the beginning-limit after summer solstice or the end-limit after winter solstice, if equal to or below the half-limit, double it;

sentences.zh: 半限以上，覆減全限，余亦倍之；

translations.literal: Half-limit at or above, turnback subtract full limit; remainder also double it;
translations.idiomatic: if above the half-limit, subtract the full limit in reverse and double the remainder as well;

sentences.zh: 並入限日，三因，四除，以日為分，十分為寸，以加地中二至晷差，為法；

translations.literal: Together entry-limit days, three multiply, four divide, with day for fen, ten fen for cun, use to add central-earth two-solstice gnomon difference, for divisor;
translations.idiomatic: Add the days within the limit, multiply by three, and divide by four; take days as parts and ten parts as one cun, add to the central-earth solstitial gnomon difference to obtain the divisor;

sentences.zh: 置所求日地中晷影定數，以地中夏至晷影常數減之，余以其處二至晷差乘之，為實；

translations.literal: Set sought day central-earth gnomon shadow fixed number; with central-earth summer solstice gnomon shadow constant number subtract it; remainder with its place two-solstice gnomon difference multiply it; for dividend;
translations.idiomatic: Set the fixed central-earth gnomon shadow for the sought day, subtract the central-earth summer-solstice gnomon-shadow constant, and multiply the remainder by that place's solstitial gnomon difference for the dividend;

sentences.zh: 實如法而一，所得，以加其處夏至晷數，即得其處其日晷影定數。

translations.literal: Dividend as divisor and one; what is obtained, use to add its place summer solstice gnomon number; then obtain its place that day's gnomon shadow fixed number.
translations.idiomatic: Divide the dividend by the divisor; add the result to that place's summer-solstice gnomon length to obtain the fixed gnomon shadow for that place on that day.

translations.idiomatic: Ascent-descent rates before and after the equinoxes.

translations.literal: Spring division before three days, sun enters red path inner; autumn division after three days, sun exits red path outer; therefore its ascent-descent with other days not of a kind; now each separately establish numbers and use them.
translations.idiomatic: Three days before the spring equinox the sun enters within the equator, and three days after the autumn equinox it exits beyond the equator; therefore its ascent and descent do not match other days, and separate numbers are now established and used for each.

sentences.zh: 求每日日出入晨昏半晝分

translations.literal: Seek each day sun entry-exit dawn-dusk half-day fen.
translations.idiomatic: To find each day's sunrise, sunset, dawn, dusk, and half-day parts.

sentences.zh: 各以陟降初率，陟減降加其氣初日日出分，為一日下日出分；

translations.literal: Each with ascent-descent beginning-rate, ascending subtract descending add its qi's first-day sun-rise-out fen, for one day below sun-rise-out fen;
translations.idiomatic: For each term, apply the initial ascent-descent rate—subtract when ascending and add when descending—to the first day's sunrise parts of that qi to obtain the sunrise parts below day one;

sentences.zh: 以增損差

translations.literal: With increase-decrease difference
translations.idiomatic: with the increase-decrease difference

translations.idiomatic: (still apply the additive-subtractive correction.)〉

sentences.zh: 增損陟降率，馴積而加減之，即為每日日出分；

translations.literal: Increase-decrease ascent-descent rates, tame accumulation and add-subtract them; then each day sun-rise-out fen;
translations.idiomatic: Increase or decrease the ascent-descent rates and apply them in sequential accumulation to obtain each day's sunrise parts;

sentences.zh: 覆減日法，余為日入分；

translations.literal: Turnback subtract day unit; remainder for sun-entry fen;
translations.idiomatic: subtract in reverse from the day unit to obtain the sunset parts;

sentences.zh: 以日出分減日入分，半之，為半晝分；

translations.literal: With sun-rise-out fen subtract sun-entry fen, halve it, for half-day fen;
translations.idiomatic: subtract sunrise parts from sunset parts and halve the result for the half-day parts;

sentences.zh: 以昏明分減日出分，為晨分；

translations.literal: With twilight fen subtract sun-rise-out fen, for dawn fen;
translations.idiomatic: subtract twilight parts from sunrise parts to obtain dawn parts;

sentences.zh: 加日入分，為昏分。

translations.literal: Add sun-entry fen, for dusk fen.
translations.idiomatic: add sunset parts to obtain dusk parts.

sentences.zh: 求日出入辰刻

translations.literal: Seek sun entry-exit chen ke.
translations.idiomatic: To find the double-hours and quarter-hours of sunrise and sunset.

sentences.zh: 置日出入分，以六因之，滿辰法而一，為辰數；

translations.literal: Set sun entry-exit fen, with six multiply it, full chen method and one, for chen count;
translations.idiomatic: Set the sunrise-sunset parts, multiply by six, and divide by the double-hour divisor to obtain the double-hour count;

sentences.zh: 不盡，刻法除之，為刻，不滿為分。

translations.literal: Not exhausted, ke method divide it, for ke; not full for fen.
translations.idiomatic: with the remainder, divide by the quarter-hour divisor to obtain quarter-hours, and what does not fill becomes parts.

sentences.zh: 命子正算外，即得所求。

translations.literal: Count from zi zheng beyond the rod; then obtain what is sought.
translations.idiomatic: Count from midnight beyond the counting rod to obtain the result sought.

sentences.zh: 求晝夜刻

translations.literal: Seek day-night ke.
translations.idiomatic: To find the day and night quarter-hours.

sentences.zh: 置日出分，十二乘之，刻法而一，為刻，不滿為分，即為夜刻；

translations.literal: Set sun-rise-out fen, twelve multiply it, ke method and one, for ke, not full for fen, then night ke;
translations.idiomatic: Set the sunrise parts, multiply by twelve, and divide by the quarter-hour divisor to obtain quarter-hours and parts as the night quarter-hours;

sentences.zh: 覆減一百，余為晝刻及分秒。

translations.literal: Turnback subtract one hundred; remainder for day ke and fen seconds.
translations.idiomatic: subtract in reverse from one hundred; the remainder is the day quarter-hours and parts-seconds.

sentences.zh: 求更點率置晨分，四因之，退位，為更率；

translations.literal: Seek watch-point rates set dawn fen, four multiply it, retreat place, for watch rate;
translations.idiomatic: To find watch and point rates: set the dawn parts, multiply by four, and shift one place to obtain the watch rate;

sentences.zh: 二因更率，退位，為點率。

translations.literal: Two multiply watch rate, retreat place, for point rate.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply the watch rate by two and shift one place to obtain the point rate.

sentences.zh: 求更點所在辰刻

translations.literal: Seek watch-point's location chen ke.
translations.idiomatic: To find the double-hour and quarter-hour of a watch or point.

sentences.zh: 置更點率，以所求更點數因之，又六因之，內加更籌刻，滿辰法而一，為辰數；

translations.literal: Set watch-point rate, with sought watch-point count multiply it, again six multiply it, inner add watch tally ke, full chen method and one, for chen count;
translations.idiomatic: Set the watch-point rate, multiply by the sought number of watches or points and again by six, add the watch tally quarter-hours within, and divide by the double-hour divisor to obtain the double-hour count;

sentences.zh: 不盡，滿刻法，除之，為刻數；

translations.literal: Not exhausted, full ke method, divide it, for ke count;
translations.idiomatic: with the remainder, divide by the quarter-hour divisor to obtain the quarter-hour count;

sentences.zh: 不滿，為分；

translations.literal: Not full, for fen;
translations.idiomatic: what does not fill becomes parts;

sentences.zh: 命其日辰刻算外，即得所求。

translations.literal: Count that day's chen ke beyond the rod; then obtain what is sought.
translations.idiomatic: count from that day's double-hour and quarter-hour beyond the counting rod to obtain the result sought.

sentences.zh: 求四方所在漏刻

translations.literal: Seek four directions' locations clepsydra ke.
translations.idiomatic: To find the clepsydra quarter-hours at each quarter of the realm.

sentences.zh: 各於所在下水漏，以定其處冬至或夏至夜刻，乃與五十刻相減，余為至差刻。

translations.literal: Each at its location lower water clepsydra, use to fix its place winter solstice or summer solstice night ke; then with fifty ke mutually subtract; remainder for solstice-difference ke.
translations.idiomatic: At each place set the water clepsydra running and fix the winter- or summer-solstice night quarter-hours there; subtract from fifty quarter-hours, and the remainder is the solstitial difference in quarter-hours.

sentences.zh: 置所求日黃道去赤道內外度及分，以至差刻乘之，進一位，如二百三十九而一，為刻；

translations.literal: Set sought day yellow path from red path inner-outer degrees and fen, with solstice-difference ke multiply it, advance one place, as two hundred thirty-nine and one, for ke;
translations.idiomatic: Set the ecliptic's degrees and parts north or south of the equator for the sought day, multiply by the solstitial-difference quarter-hours, advance one place, and divide by 239 to obtain quarter-hours;

sentences.zh: 不盡，以刻法乘之，退除為分；

translations.literal: Not exhausted, with ke method multiply it, retreat divide for fen;
translations.idiomatic: with the remainder, multiply by the quarter-hour divisor and divide down to obtain parts;

sentences.zh: 內減外加五十刻，即得所求日夜刻；

translations.literal: Inner subtract outer add fifty ke; then obtain sought day-night ke;
translations.idiomatic: subtract within and add without to fifty quarter-hours to obtain the sought day and night quarter-hours;

sentences.zh: 以減百刻，余為晝刻。

translations.literal: Use to subtract one hundred ke; remainder for day ke.
translations.idiomatic: subtract from one hundred quarter-hours; the remainder is the day quarter-hours.

translations.literal: Opening angle bracket.

sentences.zh: （其日出入辰刻及更點差率等，並依前術求之。）〉

translations.literal: (Its day entry-exit chen ke and watch-point difference rates and the like, all according to prior method seek them.)〉
translations.idiomatic: (The double-hours and quarter-hours of sunrise and sunset, watch and point difference rates, and the like are all found by the methods above.)〉

sentences.zh: 求黃道內外度

translations.literal: Seek yellow path inner-outer degrees.
translations.idiomatic: To find the ecliptic degrees north or south of the equator.

sentences.zh: 置日出之分，如日法四分之一以上，去之，余為外分；

translations.literal: Set sun-rise-out fen; if like day unit one-fourth or above, remove it; remainder for outer fen;
translations.idiomatic: Set the sunrise parts; if they reach one-quarter of the day unit or more, discard that amount; the remainder is the outer parts;

sentences.zh: 如日法四分之一以下，覆減之，余為內分。

translations.literal: If like day unit one-fourth or below, turnback subtract it; remainder for inner fen.
translations.idiomatic: If below one-quarter of the day unit, subtract in reverse; the remainder is the inner parts.

sentences.zh: 置內外分，千乘之，如內外法而一，為度，不滿，退除為分秒，即為黃道去赤道內外度；

translations.literal: Set inner-outer fen, thousand multiply them, as inner-outer divisor and one, for degrees; not full, retreat divide for fen seconds; then for yellow path from red path inner-outer degrees;
translations.idiomatic: Set the inner or outer parts, multiply by one thousand, and divide by the inner-outer divisor to obtain degrees; with the remainder, divide down for parts and seconds; this is the ecliptic's degrees north or south of the equator;

sentences.zh: 內減外加象限，即得黃道去極度。

translations.literal: Inner subtract outer add image limit; then obtain yellow path from pole degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract within and add without to the quadrant limit to obtain the ecliptic's degrees from the pole.

sentences.zh: 求距中度及更差度

translations.literal: Seek distance-from-mid degrees and watch difference degrees.
translations.idiomatic: To find the degrees from the meridian and the watch-interval difference.

sentences.zh: 置半法，以晨分減之，余為距中分；

translations.literal: Set half-divisor, with dawn fen subtract it; remainder for distance-from-mid fen;
translations.idiomatic: Set the half-divisor, subtract the dawn parts, and the remainder is the distance-from-mid parts;

sentences.zh: 百乘之，如周法而一，為距中度；

translations.literal: Hundred multiply it; as Zhou divisor and one; for distance-from-mid degrees;
translations.idiomatic: Multiply by one hundred and divide by the Zhou divisor to obtain the degrees from the meridian;

sentences.zh: 用減一百八十三度一十二分八十三秒半，余四因，退位，為每更差度。

translations.literal: Use to subtract one hundred eighty-three degrees twelve fen eighty-three seconds and a half; remainder four multiply, retreat place, for each watch difference degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract this from 183 degrees 12 parts 83½ seconds, multiply the remainder by four, shift one place, and obtain the watch-interval difference per watch.

sentences.zh: 求昏明五更中星

translations.literal: Seek dusk-dawn five watches mid-stars.
translations.idiomatic: To find the culminating stars at dusk, dawn, and the five watches.

sentences.zh: 置距中度，以其日午中赤道日度加而命之，即昏中星所格宿次，因為初更中星；

translations.literal: Set distance-from-mid degrees; with that day's noon equatorial solar degrees add and count it; then dusk mid-star's marked lodge sequence; thereby for first watch mid-star;
translations.idiomatic: Set the degrees from the meridian, add that day's noon equatorial solar degree and count in lodges; the lodge reached is the culminating star at dusk and the first watch;

sentences.zh: 以更差度累加之，滿赤道宿次，去之，即得逐更及明中星。

translations.literal: With watch difference degrees add cumulatively; full equatorial lodge sequence remove it; then obtain each watch and dawn mid-stars.
translations.idiomatic: Add the watch-interval difference cumulatively; when it fills the equatorial lodge sequence, discard the quotient; the culminating stars for each successive watch and at dawn are thereby obtained.

sentences.zh: 求晨昏月度

translations.literal: Seek dawn-dusk lunar degrees.
translations.idiomatic: To find the lunar degrees at dawn and dusk.

sentences.zh: 置其日晨分，乘其日算外轉定分，日法而一，為晨轉分；

translations.literal: Set its day dawn parts, multiply its day count-beyond fixed-revolution parts, day unit and one, for dawn revolution parts;
translations.idiomatic: Set that day's dawn parts, multiply by that day's fixed revolution parts beyond the count, divide by the day unit, and obtain the dawn revolution parts;

sentences.zh: 用減轉定分，余為昏轉分。

translations.literal: Use subtract fixed-revolution parts, remainder for dusk revolution parts.
translations.idiomatic: subtract these from the fixed revolution parts; the remainder is the dusk revolution parts.

sentences.zh: 又以朔望定小余，乘轉定分，日法而一，為加時分，以減晨昏轉分，為前；

translations.literal: Again with new moon and full moon fixed minor remainder, multiply fixed-revolution parts, day unit and one, for added-hour parts, use subtract dawn-dusk revolution parts, for before;
translations.idiomatic: Multiply the fixed revolution parts by the fixed minor remainder of the new or full moon, divide by the day unit to obtain the time-of-day parts, subtract from the dawn or dusk revolution parts for the before case;

sentences.zh: 不足，覆減之，為後；

translations.literal: not enough, turnback subtract it, for after;
translations.idiomatic: if insufficient, subtract in reverse for the after case;

sentences.zh: 乃前加後減加時月度，即晨昏月度所在宿度及分秒。

translations.literal: then before add after subtract added-hour lunar degrees, then dawn-dusk lunar degrees located lodge degrees and fen seconds.
translations.idiomatic: then add before and subtract after from the lunar degree at the time-of-day to obtain the lodge, degrees, parts, and seconds of the dawn or dusk lunar position.

sentences.zh: 求朔弦望晨昏定程

translations.literal: Seek new moon, quarter, and full moons dawn-dusk fixed interval.
translations.idiomatic: To find the fixed dawn and dusk intervals for the new moon, quarter moon, and full moon.

sentences.zh: 各以其朔昏定月減上弦昏定月，余為朔後昏定程。

translations.literal: Each with its new moon dusk fixed moon subtract first quarter dusk fixed moon, remainder for after-new-moon dusk fixed interval.
translations.idiomatic: For each, subtract the first-quarter dusk fixed moon from the new-moon dusk fixed moon; the remainder is the fixed dusk interval after the new moon.

sentences.zh: 以上弦昏定月，減望昏定月，余為上弦後昏定程。

translations.literal: With first quarter dusk fixed moon, subtract full moon dusk fixed moon, remainder for after-first-quarter dusk fixed interval.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the full-moon dusk fixed moon from the first-quarter dusk fixed moon; the remainder is the fixed dusk interval after the first quarter.

sentences.zh: 以望晨定月，減下弦晨定月，余為望後晨定程。

translations.literal: With full moon dawn fixed moon, subtract last quarter dawn fixed moon, remainder for after-full-moon dawn fixed interval.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the last-quarter dawn fixed moon from the full-moon dawn fixed moon; the remainder is the fixed dawn interval after the full moon.

sentences.zh: 以下弦晨定月，減後朔晨定月，余為下弦後晨定程。

translations.literal: With last quarter dawn fixed moon, subtract next new moon dawn fixed moon, remainder for after-last-quarter dawn fixed interval.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the next new moon's dawn fixed moon from the last-quarter dawn fixed moon; the remainder is the fixed dawn interval after the last quarter.

sentences.zh: 求每日轉定度

translations.literal: Seek each day fixed-revolution degrees.
translations.idiomatic: To find the daily fixed revolution degrees.

sentences.zh: 累計每定程相距日下轉積度，與晨昏定程相減，余以相距日數除之，為日差；

translations.literal: Accumulate count each fixed interval mutual-distance day below entry-into-revolution accumulation degrees, with dawn-dusk fixed interval mutually subtract, remainder with mutual-distance day count divide it, for day-difference;
translations.idiomatic: Accumulate the entry-into-revolution degrees under each fixed interval between the days, subtract the dawn or dusk fixed interval, divide the remainder by the number of intervening days, and obtain the day-difference;

translations.literal: Opening angle bracket.

sentences.zh: （定程多，加之；

translations.literal: (Fixed interval more, add it;
translations.idiomatic: (if the fixed interval is greater, add;

sentences.zh: 定程少，減之。）〉

translations.literal: fixed interval less, subtract it.)〉
translations.idiomatic: if less, subtract.)〉

sentences.zh: 以加減每日轉定分，為轉定度；

translations.literal: Use add-subtract each day fixed-revolution parts, for fixed-revolution degrees;
translations.idiomatic: add or subtract this from each day's fixed revolution parts to obtain the fixed revolution degrees;

sentences.zh: 因朔弦望晨昏月，每日累加之，滿宿次去之，為每日晨昏月度及分秒。

translations.literal: Follow new moon, quarter, and full moons dawn-dusk moon, each day accumulate-add it, full lodge sequence remove it, for each day dawn-dusk lunar degrees and fen seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Starting from the dawn or dusk moon at the new moon, quarter moon, or full moon, add cumulatively each day, cast out full lodges, and obtain the dawn or dusk lunar degree with parts and seconds for each day.

translations.literal: Opening angle bracket.

sentences.zh: （凡註歷，朔日已後註昏月，望後一日註晨月。）〉

translations.literal: (Whenever annotate calendar, new moon day after annotate dusk moon, full moon day after one day annotate dawn moon.)〉
translations.idiomatic: (In calendar annotation, record the dusk moon from the new-moon day onward and the dawn moon from the day after the full moon.)〉

sentences.zh: 古歷有九道月度，其數雖繁，亦難削去，具其術如後。

translations.literal: Ancient calendars had nine-path lunar degrees; its numbers although numerous, also hard cut remove, present its procedure as after.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier calendars included nine-path lunar monthly degrees; though the figures are numerous and hard to omit, the procedure is set forth below.

sentences.zh: 求正交日辰

translations.literal: Seek true-crossing day chen.
translations.idiomatic: To find the day and double-hour of true crossing.

sentences.zh: 置交終日及余秒，以其月經朔加時入交泛日及余秒減之，余為平交入其月經朔加時後日算及余秒；

translations.literal: Set crossing terminator day and remainder seconds, with its month mean new moon added-hour entry-crossing general day and remainder seconds subtract it, remainder for mean-crossing entry its month mean new moon added-hour after day count and remainder seconds;
translations.idiomatic: Set the crossing cycle day and remainder-seconds and subtract the general day and remainder-seconds of entry into crossing at the month's mean new moon with time-of-day; the remainder is the day count and remainder-seconds after the mean new moon with time-of-day at which mean crossing occurs;

translations.literal: Opening angle bracket.

sentences.zh: （中朔同。）〉

translations.literal: (Mid new moon same.)〉
translations.idiomatic: (the same for the mid-term new moon.)〉

sentences.zh: 以加其月中朔大小余，其大余命壬戌算外，即得平交日辰及余秒。

translations.literal: Use add its month mid new moon major-minor remainder, its major remainder count from renxu beyond the count, then obtain mean-crossing day chen and remainder seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Add the month's mid-term new moon major and minor remainders; count the major remainder from renxu beyond the counting rod to obtain the day, double-hour, and remainder-seconds of mean crossing.

translations.literal: Opening angle bracket.

sentences.zh: （求次交者，以交終日及余秒加之，如大余滿紀法，去之，命如前，即得次平交日辰及余秒也。）〉

translations.literal: (Seek next crossing, with crossing terminator day and remainder seconds add it; if major remainder full era unit, remove it, count as before, then obtain next mean-crossing day chen and remainder seconds.)〉
translations.idiomatic: (To find the next crossing, add the crossing cycle day and remainder-seconds; if the major remainder fills the era unit, cast it out and count as before to obtain the next mean-crossing day, double-hour, and remainder-seconds.)〉

sentences.zh: 求平交入轉朓朒定數

translations.literal: Seek mean-crossing entry-into-revolution waning-waxing fixed number.
translations.idiomatic: To find the waning-waxing fixed number for mean crossing's entry into revolution.

sentences.zh: 置平交小余，加其日夜半入轉，余以乘其日損益率，日法而一，所得，以損益其日下朓朒積，為定數。

translations.literal: Set mean-crossing minor remainder, add its day midnight entry-into-revolution, remainder use multiply its day increase-decrease rate, day unit and one, what is obtained, use increase-decrease its day below waning-waxing accumulation, for fixed number.
translations.idiomatic: Set the mean-crossing minor remainder, add midnight entry into revolution for that day, multiply the remainder by that day's increase-decrease rate, divide by the day unit, and apply the result to increase or decrease the waning-waxing accumulation below that day to obtain the fixed number.

sentences.zh: 求平交日辰

translations.literal: Seek mean-crossing day chen.
translations.idiomatic: To find the day and double-hour of mean crossing.

sentences.zh: 置平交小余，以平交入轉朓朒定數朓減朒加之，滿與不足，進退日辰，即得正交日辰及余秒；

translations.literal: Set mean-crossing minor remainder, with mean-crossing entry-into-revolution waning-waxing fixed number waning subtract waxing add it, full and not enough, advance-retreat day chen, then obtain true-crossing day chen and remainder seconds;
translations.idiomatic: Set the mean-crossing minor remainder, apply the waning-waxing fixed number for mean crossing's entry into revolution (subtract when waning, add when waxing), and on fullness or shortfall advance or retreat the day and double-hour to obtain the true-crossing day, double-hour, and remainder-seconds;

sentences.zh: 與定朔日辰相距，即得所在月日。

translations.literal: With fixed new moon day chen mutual-distance, then obtain located month day.
translations.idiomatic: compare with the fixed new moon day and double-hour to obtain the month and day.

sentences.zh: 求中朔加時中積

translations.literal: Seek mid new moon added-hour mid-accumulation.
translations.idiomatic: To find the mid-accumulation at the mid-term new moon with time-of-day.

sentences.zh: 各以其月中朔加時入氣日及余，加其氣中積及余，其日命為度，其餘，以日法退除為分秒，即其月中朔加時中積度及分秒。

translations.literal: Each with its month mid new moon added-hour entry-into-qi day and remainder, add its qi mid-accumulation and remainder, its day count for degrees, its remainder, with day unit retreat divide for fen seconds, then its month mid new moon added-hour mid-accumulation degrees and fen seconds.
translations.idiomatic: For each, add the day and remainder of entry into a qi at the month's mid-term new moon with time-of-day to the mid-accumulation and remainder of that qi; count the days as degrees, divide the remainder down by the day unit into parts and seconds, and obtain the mid-accumulation in degrees, parts, and seconds at the mid-term new moon with time-of-day.

sentences.zh: 求正交加時黃道月度

translations.literal: Seek true-crossing added-hour yellow path lunar degrees.
translations.idiomatic: To find the ecliptic lunar degree at true crossing with time-of-day.

sentences.zh: 置平交入中朔加時後日算及余秒，以日法通日內余進二位，如三萬九千一百二十一為度，不滿，退除為分秒，以加其月中朔加時中積，然後以冬至加時黃道日度加而命之，即得其月正交加時月離黃道宿度及分秒。

translations.literal: Set mean-crossing entry mid new moon added-hour after day count and remainder seconds, with day unit communicate day within remainder advance two places, as thirty-nine thousand one hundred twenty-one for degrees, not full, retreat divide for fen seconds, use add its month mid new moon added-hour mid-accumulation, then with winter solstice added-hour yellow path solar degrees add and count it, then obtain its month true-crossing added-hour moon departure yellow path lodge degrees and fen seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Set the day count and remainder-seconds after mean crossing at the mid-term new moon with time-of-day, convert the remainder within the day through the day unit advancing two places, take 39,121 as the divisor for degrees, divide down the remainder into parts and seconds, add to the mid-accumulation at the mid-term new moon with time-of-day, then add and count from the ecliptic solar degree at the winter solstice with time-of-day to obtain the ecliptic lodge, degree, parts, and seconds of the moon's departure at true crossing with time-of-day for that month.

sentences.zh: 如求次交者，以交中度及分秒加而命之，即得所求。

translations.literal: If seek next crossing, with crossing mid-degrees and fen seconds add and count it, then obtain what is sought.
translations.idiomatic: To find the next crossing, add the crossing mid-arc in degrees, parts, and seconds and count in lodges to obtain the result.

sentences.zh: 求黃道宿積度

translations.literal: Seek yellow path lodge accumulation degrees.
translations.idiomatic: To find the accumulated ecliptic lodge degrees.

sentences.zh: 置正交加時黃道宿全度，以正交加時月離黃道宿度及分秒減之，余為距後度及分秒；

translations.literal: Set true-crossing added-hour yellow path lodge full degrees, with true-crossing added-hour moon departure yellow path lodge degrees and fen seconds subtract it, remainder for distance-after degrees and fen seconds;
translations.idiomatic: Set the full ecliptic lodge degree at true crossing with time-of-day and subtract the ecliptic lodge degree, parts, and seconds of the moon's departure; the remainder is the degrees and parts-seconds after the distance;

sentences.zh: 以黃道宿度累加之，即各得正交後黃道宿積度及分秒。

translations.literal: With yellow path lodge degrees accumulate-add it, then each obtains true-crossing after yellow path lodge accumulation degrees and fen seconds.
translations.idiomatic: add the ecliptic lodge degrees cumulatively to obtain the accumulated ecliptic lodge degrees and parts-seconds after each true crossing.

sentences.zh: 求黃道宿積度入初末限

translations.literal: Seek yellow path lodge accumulation degrees entry initial-final limit.
translations.idiomatic: To find entry into the initial or final limit for accumulated ecliptic lodge degrees.

sentences.zh: 置黃道宿積度及分秒，滿交象度及分秒去之，余在半交象以下為初限；

translations.literal: Set yellow path lodge accumulation degrees and fen seconds, full crossing image degrees and fen seconds remove it, remainder at half-crossing image or below for initial limit;
translations.idiomatic: Set the accumulated ecliptic lodge degrees and parts-seconds, cast out full crossing-image degrees and parts-seconds; if the remainder is at or below half the crossing image, it is the initial limit;

sentences.zh: 以上者，減交象度，余為末限。

translations.literal: above, subtract crossing image degrees, remainder for final limit.
translations.idiomatic: if above, subtract the crossing-image degrees; the remainder is the final limit.

translations.literal: Opening angle bracket.

sentences.zh: （入交積度、交象度，並在《交會篇》中。）〉

translations.literal: (Entry-crossing accumulation degrees, crossing image degrees, both in "Crossing Conjunctions" chapter.)〉
translations.idiomatic: (Entry-crossing accumulation degrees and crossing-image degrees are both in the Crossing Conjunctions chapter.)〉

sentences.zh: 求月行九道宿度

translations.literal: Seek moon motion nine-path lodge degrees.
translations.idiomatic: To find the lodge degrees of the moon's nine paths.

sentences.zh: 凡月行所交，冬入陰歷，夏入陽歷，月行青道；

translations.literal: Whenever moon motion what crosses, winter enter yin calendar, summer enter yang calendar, moon moves green path;
translations.idiomatic: Whenever the moon crosses, in winter it enters the yin calendar and in summer the yang calendar, and the moon moves on the green path;

translations.literal: Opening angle bracket.

sentences.zh: （冬至夏至後，青道半交在春分之宿，當黃道東；

translations.literal: (After winter solstice and summer solstice, green path half-crossing at spring equinox's lodge, corresponds yellow path east;
translations.idiomatic: (After the winter and summer solstices, the green path's half-crossing lies at the lodge of the spring equinox, east of the ecliptic;

sentences.zh: 立冬立夏後，青道半交在立春之宿，當黃道東南；

translations.literal: after start-of-winter and start-of-summer, green path half-crossing at start-of-spring's lodge, corresponds yellow path southeast;
translations.idiomatic: after Start of Winter and Start of Summer, the green path's half-crossing lies at the lodge of Start of Spring, southeast of the ecliptic;

sentences.zh: 至所沖之宿，亦皆如之也。

translations.literal: reaching opposed lodge, also all like it.
translations.idiomatic: at the opposed lodge it is likewise.

sentences.zh: 宜細推。）〉

translations.idiomatic: This should be worked out in detail.)〉

sentences.zh: 冬入陽歷，夏入陰歷，月行白道；

translations.literal: Winter enter yang calendar, summer enter yin calendar, moon moves white path;
translations.idiomatic: In winter it enters the yang calendar and in summer the yin calendar, and the moon moves on the white path;

translations.literal: Opening angle bracket.

sentences.zh: （冬至夏至後，白道半交在秋分之宿，當黃道西；

translations.literal: (After winter solstice and summer solstice, white path half-crossing at autumn equinox's lodge, corresponds yellow path west;
translations.idiomatic: (After the winter and summer solstices, the white path's half-crossing lies at the lodge of the autumn equinox, west of the ecliptic;

sentences.zh: 立冬立夏後，白道半交在立秋之宿，當黃道西北；

translations.literal: after start-of-winter and start-of-summer, white path half-crossing at start-of-autumn's lodge, corresponds yellow path northwest;
translations.idiomatic: after Start of Winter and Start of Summer, the white path's half-crossing lies at the lodge of Start of Autumn, northwest of the ecliptic;

sentences.zh: 至所沖之宿，亦如之也。）〉

sentences.zh: 春入陽歷，秋入陰歷，月行朱道；

translations.literal: Spring enter yang calendar, autumn enter yin calendar, moon moves vermilion path;
translations.idiomatic: In spring it enters the yang calendar and in autumn the yin calendar, and the moon moves on the vermilion path;

translations.literal: Opening angle bracket.

sentences.zh: （春分秋分後，朱道半交在夏至之宿，當黃道南；

translations.literal: (After spring equinox and autumn equinox, vermilion path half-crossing at summer solstice's lodge, corresponds yellow path south;
translations.idiomatic: (After the spring and autumn equinoxes, the vermilion path's half-crossing lies at the lodge of the summer solstice, south of the ecliptic;

sentences.zh: 立春立秋後，朱道半交在立夏之宿，當黃道西南；

translations.literal: after start-of-spring and start-of-autumn, vermilion path half-crossing at start-of-summer's lodge, corresponds yellow path southwest;
translations.idiomatic: after Start of Spring and Start of Autumn, the vermilion path's half-crossing lies at the lodge of Start of Summer, southwest of the ecliptic;

sentences.zh: 至所沖之宿，亦如之也。）〉

translations.literal: reaching opposed lodge, also like it.)〉
translations.idiomatic: at the opposed lodge it is likewise.)〉

sentences.zh: 春入陰歷，秋入陽歷，月行黑道。

translations.literal: Spring enter yin calendar, autumn enter yang calendar, moon moves black path.
translations.idiomatic: In spring it enters the yin calendar and in autumn the yang calendar, and the moon moves on the black path.

translations.literal: Opening angle bracket.

sentences.zh: （春分秋分後，黑道半交在冬至之宿，當黃道北；

translations.literal: (After spring equinox and autumn equinox, black path half-crossing at winter solstice's lodge, corresponds yellow path north;
translations.idiomatic: (After the spring and autumn equinoxes, the black path's half-crossing lies at the lodge of the winter solstice, north of the ecliptic;

sentences.zh: 立春立秋後，黑道半交在立冬之宿，當黃道東北；

translations.literal: after start-of-spring and start-of-autumn, black path half-crossing at start-of-winter's lodge, corresponds yellow path northeast;
translations.idiomatic: after Start of Spring and Start of Autumn, the black path's half-crossing lies at the lodge of Start of Winter, northeast of the ecliptic;

sentences.zh: 至所沖之宿，亦如之也。）〉

translations.literal: reaching opposed lodge, also like it.)〉
translations.idiomatic: at the opposed lodge it is likewise.)〉

sentences.zh: 四時離為八節，至陰陽之所交，皆與黃道相會，故月行有九道。

translations.literal: Four seasons separate into eight nodes, reaching yin-yang's mutual crossing, all with yellow path meet, therefore moon motion has nine paths.
translations.idiomatic: The four seasons divide into eight nodes; where yin and yang cross, all meet the ecliptic; hence the moon has nine paths.

sentences.zh: 各以所入初末限度及分，減一百一度，余以所入初入初末限度及分乘之，半而退位為分，分滿百為度，命為月道與黃道泛差。

translations.literal: Each with entered initial-final limit degrees and fen, subtract one hundred one degrees, remainder with entered initial-entry initial-final limit degrees and fen multiply it, half and retreat place for fen, fen full hundred for degrees, count for moon path and yellow path general difference.
translations.idiomatic: For each, take the entered initial or final limit in degrees and parts, subtract 101 degrees, multiply the remainder by the degrees and parts of entry into the initial limit within the initial or final limit, halve and shift one place for parts, convert parts filling 100 to degrees, and name the result the general difference between the lunar path and the ecliptic.

sentences.zh: 凡日以赤道內為陰，外為陽；

translations.literal: Whenever sun with red path within for yin, without for yang;
translations.idiomatic: For the sun, within the equator is yin and without is yang;

sentences.zh: 月以黃道內為陰，外為陽。

translations.literal: moon with yellow path within for yin, without for yang.
translations.idiomatic: for the moon, within the ecliptic is yin and without is yang.

sentences.zh: 故月行正交，入夏至後宿度內為同名，入冬至後宿度內為異名。

translations.literal: Therefore moon motion true-crossing, enter summer solstice after lodge degrees within for same-name, enter winter solstice after lodge degrees within for different-name.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore at true lunar crossing, degrees within lodges after the summer solstice are same-name and those after the winter solstice are different-name.

sentences.zh: 其在同名者，置月行與黃道泛差，九因之，八約之，為定差；

translations.literal: Its at same-name, set moon motion and yellow path general difference, nine multiply it, eight reduce it, for fixed difference;
translations.idiomatic: In the same-name case, set the general difference between the lunar motion and the ecliptic, multiply by nine and reduce by eight to obtain the fixed difference;

sentences.zh: 半交後，正交前，以差減；

translations.literal: half-crossing after, true-crossing before, with difference subtract;
translations.idiomatic: after half-crossing and before true crossing, subtract the difference;

sentences.zh: 正交後，半交前，以差加；

translations.literal: true-crossing after, half-crossing before, with difference add;
translations.idiomatic: after true crossing and before half-crossing, add the difference;

translations.literal: Opening angle bracket.

sentences.zh: （此加減出入六度，異如黃赤道相交同名之差，若較之漸異，則隨交所在遷變不常。）〉

translations.literal: (This add-subtract exits-enters six degrees, different like yellow-red paths mutual-crossing same-name's difference, if compare it gradually different, then follow crossing located shift-change not constant.)〉
translations.idiomatic: (This addition and subtraction varies by six degrees, unlike the same-name difference at ecliptic-equator crossing; compared gradually it diverges and shifts with the crossing location.)〉

sentences.zh: 仍以正交度距秋分度數，乘定差，如象限而一，所得，為月道與赤道定差；

translations.literal: Still with true-crossing degrees distance autumn equinox degrees, multiply fixed difference, as image limit and one, what is obtained, for moon path and red path fixed difference;
translations.idiomatic: Still multiply the fixed difference by the true-crossing degrees' distance from the autumn equinox and divide by the quadrant to obtain the fixed difference between the lunar path and the equator;

sentences.zh: 前加者為減，減者為加。

translations.literal: before add for subtract, subtract for add.
translations.idiomatic: what was added before becomes subtraction and what was subtracted becomes addition.

sentences.zh: 其在異名者，置月行與黃道泛差，七因之，八約之，為定差；

translations.literal: Its at different-name, set moon motion and yellow path general difference, seven multiply it, eight reduce it, for fixed difference;
translations.idiomatic: In the different-name case, set the general difference between the lunar motion and the ecliptic, multiply by seven and reduce by eight to obtain the fixed difference;

sentences.zh: 半交後，正交前，以差加；

translations.literal: half-crossing after, true-crossing before, with difference add;
translations.idiomatic: after half-crossing and before true crossing, add the difference;

sentences.zh: 正交後，半交前，以差減；

translations.literal: true-crossing after, half-crossing before, with difference subtract;
translations.idiomatic: after true crossing and before half-crossing, subtract the difference;

translations.literal: Opening angle bracket.

sentences.zh: （此加減出入六度，正如黃赤道相交異名之差，若較之漸同，則隨交所在遷變不常。）〉

translations.literal: (This add-subtract entry-exit six degrees, just like yellow-red intersection different-name difference; if comparing them gradually alike, then following crossing's location shift-change not constant.)〉
translations.idiomatic: (This addition and subtraction of six degrees in and out is just like the difference of unlike names at the yellow-red intersection; if compared they gradually coincide, the shift varies irregularly with the location of the node.)〉

sentences.zh: 仍以正交度距春分度數，乘定差，如象限而一，所得，為月道與赤道定差；

translations.literal: Again use true-crossing degrees' distance from spring-equinox degrees; multiply fixed difference; as image limit and one; what is obtained, for lunar path and equator fixed difference;
translations.idiomatic: Again multiply the fixed difference by the true-crossing degrees' distance from the spring equinox and divide by the quadrant limit; the result is the fixed difference between the lunar path and the equator;

sentences.zh: 前加者為減，減者為加，各加減黃道宿積度，為九道宿積度；

translations.literal: What was added before becomes subtract; what was subtracted becomes add; each add-subtract yellow-path lodge accumulated degrees; for nine-path lodge accumulated degrees;
translations.idiomatic: what was previously added becomes subtraction and what was subtracted becomes addition; add or subtract each from the accumulated ecliptic lodge degrees to obtain the accumulated nine-path lodge degrees;

sentences.zh: 以前宿九道積度減之，為其宿九道度及分秒。

translations.literal: With previous lodge's nine-path accumulated degrees subtract it; for its lodge's nine-path degrees and fen seconds.
translations.idiomatic: subtract the previous lodge's accumulated nine-path degrees to obtain that lodge's nine-path degrees and parts-seconds.

translations.literal: Opening angle bracket.

sentences.zh: （其分就近約為太、半、少，論春夏秋冬，以四時日所在宿度為正。）〉

translations.literal: (Its fen, by proximity, approximate as greater, half, lesser; discussing spring summer autumn winter, with four seasons' sun's located lodge degrees as standard.)〉
translations.idiomatic: (The parts are rounded to the nearest large, half, or small degree; for spring, summer, autumn, and winter, the lodge degrees where the sun stands in each season serve as the standard.)〉

sentences.zh: 求正交加時月離九道宿度

translations.literal: Seek true-crossing added-hour moon's departure nine-path lodge degrees.
translations.idiomatic: To find the nine-path lodge degree of the moon's departure at true conjunction with time-of-day.

sentences.zh: 以正交加時黃道日度及分，減一百一度，余以正交度及分乘之，半而退位為分，分滿百為度，命為月道與黃道泛差。

translations.literal: With true-crossing added-hour yellow-path solar degrees and fen, subtract 101 degrees; remainder with true-crossing degrees and fen multiply it; halve and retreat place for fen; fen full 100 for degrees; count as lunar path and yellow-path general difference.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract 101 degrees from the ecliptic solar degree and parts at true conjunction with time-of-day; multiply the remainder by the true-crossing degrees and parts, halve and shift down for parts, and when parts fill 100 convert to degrees; this is called the general difference between the lunar path and the ecliptic.

sentences.zh: 其在同名者，置月行與黃道泛差，九因之，八約之，為定差，以加；

translations.literal: Those in like name: set lunar motion and yellow-path general difference; nine multiply it; eight reduce it; for fixed difference; use to add;
translations.idiomatic: When of like name, set the lunar motion and ecliptic general difference, multiply by nine and reduce by eight to obtain the fixed difference, and add it;

sentences.zh: 仍以正交度距秋分度數乘定差，如象限而一，所得，為月道與赤道定差，以減。

translations.literal: Again use true-crossing degrees' distance from autumn-equinox degrees multiply fixed difference; as image limit and one; what is obtained, for lunar path and equator fixed difference; use to subtract.
translations.idiomatic: Again multiply the fixed difference by the true-crossing degrees' distance from the autumn equinox and divide by the quadrant limit; the result is the fixed difference between the lunar path and the equator, and subtract it.

sentences.zh: 其異名者，置月行與黃道泛差，七因之，八約之，為定差，以減；

translations.literal: Those of unlike name: set lunar motion and yellow-path general difference; seven multiply it; eight reduce it; for fixed difference; use to subtract;
translations.idiomatic: When of unlike name, set the lunar motion and ecliptic general difference, multiply by seven and reduce by eight to obtain the fixed difference, and subtract it;

sentences.zh: 仍以正交度距春分度數，乘定差，如象限而一，所得，為月道與赤道定差，以加。

translations.literal: Again use true-crossing degrees' distance from spring-equinox degrees; multiply fixed difference; as image limit and one; what is obtained, for lunar path and equator fixed difference; use to add.
translations.idiomatic: Again multiply the fixed difference by the true-crossing degrees' distance from the spring equinox and divide by the quadrant limit; the result is the fixed difference between the lunar path and the equator, and add it.

sentences.zh: 置正交加時黃道月度及分，以二差加減之，即為正交加時月離九道宿度及分。

translations.literal: Set true-crossing added-hour yellow-path lunar degree and fen; with two differences add-subtract it; then is true-crossing added-hour moon's departure nine-path lodge degrees and fen.
translations.idiomatic: Set the ecliptic lunar degree and parts at true conjunction with time-of-day, add or subtract the two differences, and the nine-path lodge degree and parts of the moon's departure at true conjunction with time-of-day are obtained.

sentences.zh: 求定朔弦望加時月所在度

translations.literal: Seek fixed new moon, quarter, and full moons' added-hour moon's located degree.
translations.idiomatic: To find the degree occupied by the moon at the true new moon, quarter moon, and full moon with time-of-day.

sentences.zh: 置定朔加時日躔黃道宿次，凡合朔加時，月行潛在日下，與太陽同度，是為加時月離宿次；

translations.literal: Set fixed new moon added-hour sun's motion yellow-path lodge sequence; whenever conjunction added-hour, lunar motion hidden below sun, with sun same degree; this is added-hour moon's departure lodge sequence;
translations.idiomatic: Set the ecliptic lodge position of the sun at the true new moon with time-of-day; whenever it is conjunction with time-of-day, the moon moves hidden beneath the sun at the same degree, and this is the lodge position of the moon's departure at that hour;

sentences.zh: 各以弦望度及分秒，加其所當弦望加時日躔黃道宿度，滿宿次，去之，命如前，各得定朔弦望加時月所在黃道宿度及分秒。

translations.literal: Each with quarter-full moon degrees and fen seconds, add its corresponding quarter-full moon added-hour sun's motion yellow-path lodge degrees; full lodge sequence remove it; count as before; each obtains fixed new moon quarter-full moons added-hour moon's located yellow-path lodge degrees and fen seconds.
translations.idiomatic: For each, add the quarter- or full-moon degrees and parts-seconds to the ecliptic solar degree at the corresponding quarter or full moon with time-of-day, discard full lodges as before, and the ecliptic lodge, degrees, and parts-seconds occupied by the moon at each true new moon, quarter moon, and full moon with time-of-day are thereby obtained.

sentences.zh: 求定朔弦望加時九道月度

translations.literal: Seek fixed new moon quarter-full moons added-hour nine-path lunar degree.
translations.idiomatic: To find the nine-path lunar degree at the true new moon, quarter moon, and full moon with time-of-day.

sentences.zh: 各以定朔弦望加時月離黃道宿度及分秒，加前宿正交後黃道積度，為定朔弦望加時正交後黃道積度；

translations.literal: Each with fixed new moon quarter-full moons added-hour moon's departure yellow-path lodge degrees and fen seconds, add previous lodge's after-true-crossing yellow-path accumulated degrees; for fixed new moon quarter-full moons added-hour after-true-crossing yellow-path accumulated degrees;
translations.idiomatic: For each, add the moon's departure ecliptic lodge degrees and parts-seconds at the true new moon, quarter moon, or full moon with time-of-day to the accumulated ecliptic degrees after true crossing at the previous lodge, obtaining the accumulated ecliptic degrees after true crossing at that hour;

sentences.zh: 如前求九道積度，以前宿九道積度減之，余為定朔弦望加時九道月離宿度及分秒。

translations.literal: As before seek nine-path accumulated degrees; with previous lodge's nine-path accumulated degrees subtract it; remainder is fixed new moon quarter-full moons added-hour nine-path moon's departure lodge degrees and fen seconds.
translations.idiomatic: as before, find the nine-path accumulated degrees and subtract the previous lodge's accumulated nine-path degrees; the remainder is the nine-path lodge, degrees, and parts-seconds of the moon's departure at the true new moon, quarter moon, or full moon with time-of-day.

translations.literal: Opening angle bracket.

sentences.zh: （其合朔加時，若非正交，則日在黃道，月在九道，所入宿度雖多少不同，考其兩極若繩準。

translations.literal: (Its conjunction added-hour, if not true crossing, then sun in yellow-path, moon in nine-path; entered lodge degrees although more-less different, examine its two poles like cord standard.
translations.idiomatic: (At conjunction with time-of-day, if it is not true crossing, the sun is on the ecliptic and the moon on the nine paths; the lodges entered may differ in degree, but examine the two poles as if by a plumb line.

sentences.zh: 故云月行潛在日下，與太陽同度，即為加時。

translations.literal: Therefore say lunar motion hidden below sun, with sun same degree; then is added-hour.
translations.idiomatic: Hence it is said that the moon moves hidden beneath the sun at the same degree, and that is the time-of-day.

sentences.zh: 九道月度，求其晨昏夜半月度，並依前術。）〉

translations.literal: Nine-path lunar degree; seek its dawn, dusk, and midnight lunar degrees; all follow previous method.)〉
translations.idiomatic: For nine-path lunar degrees, find the lunar degrees at dawn, dusk, and midnight by the same methods as above.)〉
